feeds.title: Honolulu Star-Advertiser
feeds.description: Honolulu Star-Advertiser is your source for breaking news, local coverage, sports, business and more. Covering Honolulu and Hawaii news, business, sports, entertainment, and weather.

feeds.title: The Hawaii Vacation Guide » Oahu
feeds.description: We are Hawaii travelers who have lived on Maui and Oahu sharing our adventures, travel tips and resources, and honest reviews so you can easily plan your dream vacation to Hawaii. Here, on this page we specifically share are experience living in Oahu and its specialty.

feeds.title: HONOLULU Magazine
feeds.description: Read stories about climate change in Hawai'i and what is being done. Honolulu Magazine is a quality, four-color magazine reaching Hawai'i's best-educated and most affluent residents and takes an unblinking look at contemporary issues.

feeds.title: Lincoln Travel Co » Oahu
feeds.description: Hello, friend! I'm Caity Lincoln. I moved to Maui for a spell after I finished grad school and after a year of showing my steady stream of visitors around the island, I started this blog to share everything I'd learned. My goal with this blog is always to help you plan the kind of trip you want. Read travel tips, places to visit, and things to do while in Oahu on my blog page.

feeds.title: Next is Hawaii » Honolulu
feeds.description: Next is Hawaii a Hawaii travel blog that wants to help you plan your trip to the islands with confidence! You will find plenty of guides detailing things to do in Hawaii, where to stay, and so much more! We cover every corner and street in Honolulu for you so you don't have to waste any time while visiting the place.

feeds.title: Shoreline Hotel Waikiki Blog
feeds.description: From sunrise to sunset, our 135-room hotel transforms from warm, bright and airy in the day, to cool, moody and electric at night, an atmosphere inspired by the striking beauty of the Hawaiian landscape and the energy of Waikiki. We encourage you to explore the hotel and discover everything Shoreline has to offer. Escape to the islands and come relax with us!

feeds.title: Hawaii Foodbank Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest news and announcements from the Hawaii Foodbank Blog. Hawaii Foodbank provides food so that no one in our family goes hungry. We work to gather food and support from our communities. We then distribute food through charitable agencies to those in need.

feeds.title: Hawaii Youth Symphony Blog
feeds.description: Latest news, events, and announcements by the Hawaii Youth Symphony. Hawaii Youth Symphony is a nonprofit dedicated to serving students statewide through instrumental music education. Our Mission is to help youth develop to their fullest potential through orchestral music, in the setting of our Islands' unique culture.

feeds.title: Hawaii Magazine
feeds.description: Hawai'i Magazine shares stories about what makes the Islands so luring and unique to mindful travelers who love and respect this place as much as Hawaiians do. The magazine inspires its readers to travel here with an open mind and heart, to malama (care for) the home, and to seek out authentic experiences through its rich and rooted storytelling in the magazine and on digital platforms.

feeds.title: HonoluluCC Blog
feeds.description: Honolulu CC offers one of the best educational values in the U.S. Honolulu Community College serves the Pacific as a premier, comprehensive community college that offers quality instruction in a wide range of career and technical education programs.

feeds.title: Wanderlustyle Blog » Oahu
feeds.description: Helping you through travel tips and guides around the Oahu! Aloha! We are Maryrose and Reid, creatives based in Hawaii. Wanderlustyle was born in April 2015, sharing a traveler's lifestyle, who still works 'normal' jobs nonetheless. We let our personal failures and accomplishments be lessons, travel tips, and recommendations for others!

feeds.title: Beach Tours Hawaii Blog
feeds.description: We love O'ahu and we want to talk about it! Welcome to our blog a place full of travel tips and reviews to prepare you next trip to Hawaii. O'ahu is our home and we love it, we are an Aloha ambassador company, which means that for us love, family, friendship and good vibes are always a priority as a lifestyle, here in Hawaii we never stop learning about what life offers us, and how lucky we are.

feeds.title: Valia Honolulu Blog
feeds.description: Valia Honolulu was founded in November 2016 by the owner, Camille Heung. On the Blog at Valia Honolulu, we open up with some insights on our business, behind-the-scenes looks, styling tips, brand features, and more! If you're a small business owner, you'll find tips and shared experiences. If you love classic styling tips, we share those as well!

feeds.title: Great Eats Hawaii Blog
feeds.description: On Great Eats Hawaii Blog you'll find honest reviews of Hawaii restaurants and travel experiences from the Santos family in Honolulu, Hawaii.

feeds.title: Hawaii Grinds
feeds.description: Hawaii Grinds is part of the Hawaii Hui. It is dedicated to foodies in Aloha State. There's no limit to our love of all things delicious. Have a passion for dining? Grinding? Eating? We welcome contributions! Restaurant reviews, food galleries, and even just sharing stories and links of interest.
